Correct the unsupported legal characterization in source lines 13 and 18, concept wiki/concepts/stripe-currency-selector-element.md heading line 24 and source description line 64, and wiki/stripe-index.md lines 69 and 773. Preserve the must-render condition as Stripe's documented integration instruction and describe legal compliance separately.
